import cv2

import json

# Top white/grey counter top:
# Let's find the 4 corners of the counter top in frame 20
# Top surface is around y: 340-370, x: 200-410

ys, xs = np.where(counter_mask)
print(f"Counter in 20: x in [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], y in [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], center_x = {np.mean(xs):.1f}")

# Also cabinet front in frame 20:
# beige panels:
front_mask = (img20[:, :, 2] > 150) & (img20[:, :, 2] < 190) & \
             (img20[:, :, 1] > 130) & (img20[:, :, 1] < 165) & \
             (img20[:, :, 0] > 100) & (img20[:, :, 0] < 135)
ys_f, xs_f = np.where(front_mask)
print(f"Cabinet front in 20: x in [{xs_f.min()}, {xs_f.max()}], y in [{ys_f.min()}, {ys_f.max()}], center_x = {np.mean(xs_f):.1f}")
